posts.title: It just occurred to me…
posts.description: … while reading “The Swift Programming Language”, that the current format of QR codes (2d barcodes) could be used to encode a unique hexadecimal identifier for all humans who have ever lived, or probably ever will live, assuming the human race ceases to exist as such before there have been 18 quintillion of us…
